Hero Course Night Patrol Lessons.name: Hero Course Night Patrol Lessons
Hero Course Night Patrol Lessons.questStatement: Late in the year, Shota Aizawa adds the lesson the Hero Course has been asking for: supervised evening patrols through the Musutafu Station District. Teams of three walk a set route with a teacher on the radio and Aizawa somewhere on the rooftops above. The rules are strict: licenses on you, radios on, no pursuit beyond the route, nobody alone. The streets are real, the people are real, and so is whatever turns up after dark.
Hero Course Night Patrol Lessons.mainObjective: Walk a supervised patrol route with your team and handle what you meet within the rules.

completionCondition.query: The PC has completed at least one supervised evening patrol through the Musutafu Station District with their team and reported what they found to Shota Aizawa.

Hero Course Night Patrol Lessons.questDesignBrief: Street-level and grounded: a pickpocket in the Station Concourse, a drunk whose Quirk flares, a lost child looking for a parent, a heteromorph customer refused service at the convenience store, a fight brewing in the Back Alleys. Shota Aizawa watches from the rooftops and steps in only when a team breaks the rules or a life is at risk; chasing alone ends the PC's patrol with a lecture, not glory. Classmates by record name share teams. The country is uneasy and a copycat may test the PC, but nothing here stages a League attack or any canon event. A PC without a license patrols as an observer only. Children stay child-safe.
